the flow rate through a tube is a function of the tank temperature, tank stratification and tube inclination, and is also affected by the type of collector used.

the natural circulation flow rate in a single ended evacuated collector is sufficiently high to disturb the temperature stratification of the water storage.
the flow through a single tube in a solar water heater can be accurately predicted using a numerical model and validated using PIV measurements.
